_note: Two sections. active_checks[] = the SUMMARIZED, deduped, live project overlay that /critique reads before every review (the ONLY section /critique loads, so it stays small regardless of history). runs[] = append-only audit history of every /critic-calibrate run; a new run NEVER overwrites a prior one. /critic-calibrate upserts accepted proposals into active_checks (dedup by id) and appends the run to runs. agents/critique.md (the plugin base Critic) is NEVER edited from a project — recurring/generic checks are mailed to the maintainer to fold into the next plugin version.

active_checks.check: Check auth/authz on every new API endpoint and mutation path.
